features.name: Home & assistant
features.kicker: A simple starting point
features.summary: Ask about the company, plan a campaign and reach your creative tools from one place.
does: Uses the saved brand rules and current campaign context.
Keeps conversation history and can create real campaign or studio records through the same services as the editors.
Offers shortcuts to static ads, video, templates, assets and the model catalog.
steps: Choose a campaign context when your question concerns a specific offer.
Try ‘What are our brand rules?’ or use a campaign-planning shortcut.
Open the linked record in its studio to continue editing.
features.result: A saved conversation and, when an available action is used, an actual editable application record.
features.limit: The assistant is a deterministic guide today. Open-ended AI reasoning, streaming and broad source retrieval are not connected. Reviewers share one creator identity, including its conversations and preferences.

features.name: Campaigns
features.kicker: The brief that holds everything together
features.summary: Keep the campaign goal, audience, products, dates, offer and creative work together.
does: Creates and duplicates campaigns with a current offer, exact terms, CTA and destination.
Versions offer changes and keeps earlier creatives and downloads tied to their original information.
Provides the starting context for static ads, videos and remixes.
steps: Open ‘Renewal prototype · A brighter view’ or create a campaign.
Review the goal, product, audience and dates; enter the offer and required terms yourself.
Save the brief, then open a studio. Apply offer changes to the creatives you intend to update.
features.result: One saved brief with related editable creatives and versioned offer information.
features.limit: The saved example is an awareness exercise, with no promotional discount. Historical source ads are references, never automatic current offers. Saved campaign edits were verified on Vercel.

features.name: Static Studio
features.kicker: Real assets, editable layers
features.summary: Build a branded image from supplied product photography, exact logo artwork and editable copy.
does: Supports editorial, product showcase and split layouts in square, portrait and vertical formats.
Edits headlines, body text, CTA, disclosure, image crop, position and other layer settings.
Provides autosave, undo/redo, saved versions, restore and an exact saved preview.
steps: Choose a campaign, layout and imported photograph, or open a saved example.
Select a layer and edit only the part you want to change. Wait for ‘Saved’.
Check ‘Exact saved preview’, render a PNG and collect it in Activity & downloads.
features.result: An editable document and a downloadable PNG of the rendered version.
features.limit: The editor canvas is an approximation; the exact saved preview/export is authoritative for text wrapping. Font fallback is disclosed. Fresh hosted PNG rendering and download were verified; broader placement and accessibility review remains.

features.name: Video & UGC
features.kicker: Plan a story, assemble the scenes
features.summary: Turn authorized footage and images into a commercial or a UGC-style walkthrough.
does: Edits scene sources, ordering, trims, durations, captions and a branded end card.
Stores a working script, shot notes and per-scene narration direction.
Uses real source audio, recorded voice/music assets and volume controls; exports MP4 and captions where produced.
steps: Open the 15-second or 30-second real-footage example and inspect its scenes.
Change scene media, timing or captions. Use one nonempty script line per scene when applying script lines to captions.
Check audio choices and the ending, render, then preview/download the finished MP4.
features.result: A saved storyboard and playable video built from actual source media.
features.limit: Writing narration notes does not create speech. Generated scenes, presenters, cloned voices and AI video models are not connected. The examples are not customer testimonials and use muted source audio. A fresh hosted 15-second render was verified; broader audio and recovery testing remains.

features.name: Templates
features.kicker: A useful starting composition
features.summary: Start with a layout and make it your own using the company’s offer and media.
does: Offers editorial, product showcase and split composition starting points.
Opens the normal static editing flow rather than a flattened concept screenshot.
Keeps output editable so copy, source image and geometry can change.
steps: Open Templates and choose a composition.
Select the destination campaign and imported media in the studio.
Review the current copy and terms, edit, then render.
features.result: A normal private creative document that can be edited, versioned and exported.
features.limit: The full curated template catalog and its administration are still developing. A template’s appearance is not evidence of advertising performance.

features.name: Remix
features.kicker: Borrow the direction; use your own brand
features.summary: Adapt a shared or uploaded reference into a private creative for your company.
does: Selects a destination campaign and imported company media.
Records the hook, direction and explicit adaptation choices; video remixes can specify pacing, captions and scene durations.
Retains reference lineage while using the destination brand, current offer and terms.
steps: Choose a published reference or an already uploaded reference.
Pick what to adapt and write the direction; select the campaign and your own source assets.
Create the private document and finish it in Static Studio or Video & UGC.
features.result: An editable private variation with a reference trail, not access to another company’s original files.
features.limit: Uploaded references rely on manually entered direction; automatic visual analysis is not connected. Shared composition metadata excludes private source asset IDs. The full browser journey still needs wider verification.

features.name: AI Models
features.kicker: The catalog is here; generation comes next
features.summary: Browse the observed model inventory and filter by image, video or assistant use.
does: Preserves the full observed inventory instead of silently dropping model options.
Supports name search and task-type filtering.
Shows unavailable models truthfully and prevents unsupported generation submissions.
steps: Open AI Models and filter by the task you are interested in.
Search for a model name and inspect its availability.
Use the working source-media studios for the current review.
features.result: A clear view of intended model options and their current availability.
features.limit: No catalog model is enabled for live generation yet. Astra and Seedance 2.5 are preferences, not verified provider endpoints. Provider identity, access, capabilities and official logo artwork must be verified before activation.

features.name: Winning Ads
features.kicker: Shared inspiration with honest evidence
features.summary: Discover explicitly published references, inspect their context and save useful ideas.
does: Searches and filters published references by media, industry and evidence category.
Supports private saved references and named collections.
Provides reference detail, usage context and a path into a private remix.
steps: Browse the library or search for a relevant reference.
Read the evidence label and usage information before treating a reference as a result.
Save it to a collection or begin a remix for your own campaign.
features.result: A personal reference library and a reusable starting point for new creative work.
features.limit: This review starts with no published references or verified winners. ‘Winning Ads’ is the destination name, not a performance claim. Publishing is explicit, and complete evidence curation/correction remains unfinished.

features.name: Creative Insights
features.kicker: Know what the source report actually says
features.summary: Bring real ad reports into a company-scoped view of delivery and results.
does: Reads CSV columns, supports visual field mapping, previews validation and commits valid report data.
Calculates weighted spend/lead/click metrics with explicit date, account, currency and attribution scope.
Supports saved views and reviewed mapping from a reported ad to an exact creative version.
steps: Choose an actual report and map its columns in the import wizard.
Review validation and source scope before committing the import.
Filter the result set, review creative matches and open an ad’s performance detail.
features.result: Traceable report facts with calculated metrics rather than invented dashboard numbers.
features.limit: The review is empty until real reports are imported. Meta is not connected. Advanced grouping, complete cohort reconciliation and broader browser verification remain in progress.

features.name: Ad performance & next variation
features.kicker: Turn a measured result into a testable change
features.summary: Look at one reported ad, its exact creative match and a private next-test brief.
does: Shows source-ad metrics, compatible previous-period comparisons and supplied video measures.
Displays an exact rendered preview when a reviewed creative-version match exists.
Creates an evidence-bearing variation brief tied to its parent creative and current brand/offer.
steps: From an imported report, open an ad’s performance detail.
Confirm the creative mapping and comparable metric scope.
Inspect actual results separately from readiness checks, then save a next-test brief.
features.result: A private hypothesis for the next creative variation, with its source evidence attached.
features.limit: There is no numerical CPL prediction, performance percentile or AI quality score. A next-test brief is not proof that a change will improve results. Forecast and benchmark claims require evidence the review does not yet contain.

features.name: CRM outcomes
features.kicker: Look beyond the first lead
features.summary: Import validated business outcomes and understand how they relate to advertising records.
does: Imports stable lead/job identities and avoids counting repeated imports twice.
Shows unique leads, qualification, appointments, sold/canceled jobs and match coverage.
Keeps revenue currencies and accounting bases separate, with missing and unmatched data visible.
steps: Prepare an authorized CRM outcome report with stable source IDs.
Map columns, preview errors and import valid rows.
Filter source dates and account/currency; inspect unmatched attribution and outcome totals.
features.result: A reconciliable view of supplied business outcomes, not a replacement CRM.
features.limit: No real CRM data is seeded. Full acquisition-cohort costs, ROAS, ambiguous attribution and conversion-lag reconciliation remain unfinished.

features.name: Creative review
features.kicker: Check readiness before you render
features.summary: Inspect a saved creative for deterministic document-readiness checks.
does: Checks available document and campaign information and shows what is present or needs attention.
Separates these checks from actual reported advertising results.
Explains when the data is insufficient for a forecast.
steps: Open Creative review and choose a saved document.
Read each check and its explanation.
Return to the relevant studio to address the specific issue and render a new version.
features.result: A practical preparation checklist linked to the creative.
features.limit: This is not AI scoring, brand certification, a legal review or a performance guarantee. It is not an agency approval gate for downloading a ready file.

features.name: My Assets
features.kicker: The actual media behind the work
features.summary: Find imported originals and see exactly what is still waiting for intake.
does: Keeps source IDs, file metadata, checksums and provenance alongside asset status.
Retains original logos, font files, photos and footage even when preview support differs.
Makes imported media available to the studios while keeping missing/error states explicit.
steps: Browse the library and inspect an asset’s status and available preview.
Use stored photos/footage in a studio or supply authorized source files through the upload path.
Treat a catalog-only entry as a source reference until its original is successfully imported.
features.result: A traceable private company asset library.
features.limit: Seven originals are imported: official logo artwork, a font original, three photos and two video clips. The other 417 of 424 catalog entries still await import. Hosted import formats and parser coverage are not all verified.

features.name: Brand System
features.kicker: One identity across the creative work
features.summary: Inspect the company’s logo, palette, typography guidance and versioned source mappings.
does: Uses actual logo artwork and Renewal Green #6CC14C with black text.
Stores creative brand versions so earlier documents retain the identity they were made with.
Separates the interface theme from the creative design system.
steps: Open Brand System and review the official artwork, palette and font-use notes.
Use the stored rules when reviewing creative output.
A company owner can update mappings and approved font usage in the local owner workflow.
features.result: A consistent source of company identity and historical brand versions.
features.limit: Ryan’s creator access cannot change owner-controlled brand/theme settings. Imported font files do not establish hosting permission. The interface uses fallback typography; hosted rendering uses a licensed fallback until company font usage is approved.

features.name: Activity & downloads
features.kicker: From a queued task to an actual file
features.summary: Track generation work and download the outputs that are ready.
does: Persists queued, running, ready, failed, partial and canceled job states.
Supports cancellation/retry and makes partial failures visible.
Previews completed media and downloads PNG, MP4 and associated output files.
steps: Render from a studio, then open Activity & downloads.
Wait for a ready result or read the specific failure state.
Preview or download the completed version; use a focused retry when appropriate.
features.result: An actual stored file, not a success toast standing in for a render.
features.limit: The hosted review currently has eight completed renders, including two deployment-verification outputs. Long unattended queues and larger-scale recovery remain release work. Opening Activity helps queued work continue. Local usage units are not provider charges.

features.name: Campaign export
features.kicker: Package the right versions
features.summary: Select the exact finished outputs you want to download as a campaign package.
does: Scopes selection to a campaign and identifies available completed render versions.
Shows pending, canceled, missing and latest-but-unrendered states rather than silently including them.
Produces a ZIP with selected media, matching copy, manifests and captions when available.
steps: Choose a campaign and review the rendered versions.
Select the finished outputs you need; render any missing latest version first.
Download the package and confirm the selected versions are the ones you intend to use.
features.result: A version-specific delivery ZIP ready for your own advertising workflow.
features.limit: Immediate downloads require no manager or agency approval. Export does not publish an ad to Meta. The six-output hosted ZIP was downloaded and integrity-checked; broader selection/UI combinations still need review.

features.name: Feed
features.kicker: Discuss the work with the right audience
features.summary: Share ideas and ask for feedback through a persistent company or community feed.
does: Stores posts, comments, polls, reactions and private drafts.
Lets the author select company-only or shared-community audience.
Includes basic reporting/removal and keeps private source files distinct from shared creative derivatives.
steps: Choose the intended audience before writing a post.
Write a title and message, optionally add poll choices, then publish explicitly.
Open the post to comment, react or respond to the poll.
features.result: A real conversation record with an explicit audience.
features.limit: The review starts without fabricated community activity. Rich attachments, nested replies, mentions, notifications, directory and events are not complete. Community Chat/DM is not implemented. Reviewer posts use the shared review identity.

features.name: Classroom
features.kicker: Learn the tools where you use them
features.summary: Read original training guides and move directly into the relevant workspace tool.
does: Provides three original written guides for the implemented workflows.
Searches and filters eligible lesson content.
Contains media-player/resume support for lessons with actual authorized media.
steps: Open Classroom and browse or search for a topic.
Read the lesson text and its available resources.
Follow the tool link to try the workflow in the app.
features.result: Practical product guidance alongside the creative workspace.
features.limit: There are no seeded instructional recordings. Missing media is not shown as playable. Full lesson/resource administration, event archives and broader player/resume verification remain unfinished.

features.name: Settings & connections
features.kicker: Understand access, usage and availability
features.summary: See workspace membership, prototype usage, saved preferences and integration status.
does: Shows render units used/reserved and the configured allowance.
Stores preferences and exposes honest provider, Meta and billing connection states.
Supports invitations, role changes and revocation in the local owner workflow.
steps: Open Settings and inspect the integration states and usage.
Save or forget a preference if useful for this review identity.
Use the provided private link/password for review access; owner-only controls are not available to Ryan.
features.result: A clear account/setup view without implying disconnected services are live.
features.limit: Meta OAuth/sync, live billing, individual hosted accounts, recovery and email delivery remain unfinished. All reviewers share the same review creator’s conversations/preferences. The review is separate from the original local workspace.

features.name: Company setup & operations
features.kicker: The foundation for more company workspaces
features.summary: Configure companies and shared content from an internal operator workflow.
does: Creates isolated company workspaces with separate interface themes and brand setup.
Provides basic lesson/publication controls and operational failure information.
Keeps company-owned assets, campaigns and reports scoped to the company.
steps: An internal operator opens Company setup in the local development workflow.
Configure company identity, theme and permitted source mappings.
Manage eligible training/publications and review failures as appropriate.
features.result: A configurable company platform rather than a hardcoded Renewal-only product.
features.limit: This is intentionally inaccessible to Ryan’s creator review. Complete activation/lifecycle controls, audited support access, production identity and operations are still being built. Renewal is the prototype brand; another company is planned as the first live customer.

workflows.name: Make a static ad
workflows.outcome: An editable ad and a downloadable PNG.
steps: Choose the campaign
Open Campaigns and select the saved awareness exercise. Read its brief and terms before editing.
campaigns
Open a composition
In Static Studio, open an existing example or start from editorial, showcase or split layout.
static
Use real company assets
Choose an imported photograph and the mapped official logo. Catalog entries without originals cannot stand in for source media.
assets
Refine the message
Edit the headline, CTA, disclosure or crop. Wait for Saved, then check Exact saved preview for the final wrapping.
static
Render the saved version
Select Render PNG. Follow its status in Activity & downloads; a failed job should show a recoverable error.
activity
Download or package
Download the ready PNG, or choose exact completed versions in Campaign export. No manager approval is required.
export

workflows.name: Build a video
workflows.outcome: A playable MP4 with source media, captions and a branded ending.
steps: Open the saved walkthrough
In Video & UGC, start with the 15-second or 30-second real-footage example.
video
Shape the storyboard
Read the working script, scene narration and shot notes. Choose the commercial/product/UGC direction that describes the intended creative.
video
Edit the scenes
Replace one source, adjust trim/duration or reorder scenes. Review the whole sequence after a timing change.
video
Review captions and audio
Edit captions directly, or apply one script line per scene. This does not synthesize speech. Use authorized recorded audio where available.
video
Check the ending and render
Confirm the campaign message and branded end card, save, then render. Watch Activity for the actual result.
activity
Watch before using
Play the completed MP4 to check framing, timing, captions and sound. Download the version you reviewed.
export

workflows.name: Adapt a reference
workflows.outcome: A private creative using your own assets and current campaign information.
steps: Find a starting point
Use a published reference in Winning Ads or an already uploaded reference. The review library starts empty.
shared
Inspect the evidence
Read the usage and evidence labels. A visually appealing reference is not automatically a verified winner.
shared
Set the destination
Open Remix, select your campaign and choose the imported company media that will appear in the new work.
remix
Describe the changes
Choose the composition/narrative elements to adapt and write the hook or direction. Automatic visual analysis is not connected.
remix
Finish in the studio
Create the private document, review its current offer and brand, then edit/render/export through the normal studio flow.
static

workflows.name: Learn from results
workflows.outcome: A source-backed view of results and a private hypothesis for the next test.
steps: Bring an actual ad report
In Creative Insights, load a CSV report you are authorized to use. Meta’s live connection is not available yet.
insights
Map and validate
Match source columns, review row errors and choose the correct report scope before committing.
insights
Match the exact creative
Review the source ad’s association to a saved creative version. A missing match should remain explicit.
performance
Read comparable metrics
Choose compatible dates, currency and attribution. Keep actual results separate from readiness checks and forecasts.
performance
Add business outcomes
If available, import stable CRM lead/job IDs. Inspect qualification, appointments, jobs and unmatched attribution.
crm
Propose one next test
Create a private variation brief using the source evidence and current campaign. The proposed change is a hypothesis, not a promised lift.
performance
